description:
Outcome: coordinator receives one daily email listing new reports, from owner notification answer.
Scope: durable local-time scheduler, immutable batch/outbox, stable provider idempotency key, private minimal summary and authenticated detail links; recipient configuration, observability and recovery. Excludes: immediate alerts, gardener mail and empty digests.
Acceptance: include newly reported but since-resolved reports with status; no report loss on failure/restart; concurrent runners create one logical batch; only coordinator recipient. At most one successful logical digest per garden-local day.
Behaviour: missed days without existing batch consolidate outstanding reports into next scheduled batch. Freeze membership on creation. Failed/ambiguous frozen batch is reconciled/retried with same provider key at subsequent scheduled runs before creating new batch; newer reports remain durably pending for a later day. Resolve ambiguous provider status before sending another; failed batch inspectable. No impossible exactly-once claim.
Verification: fake-clock/timezone/DST, multiple missed days, concurrent scheduler, provider success/failure/timeout/retry, new reports during pending batch, daily delivery limit and sandbox rendered mail tests. Prerequisites: delivery feasibility and problem reporting. Assumptions: address/time/timezone configured before release; provider idempotency/status support established in foundation.
title: Daily new-report email
